answer_3.quote: we elicit few-shot judgments from llama-3-8b-instruct on replies (R). For each reply R on posts that survived filtering, the model performs a three-way classification: (1) R indicates that an information need was met, (2) not met, or (3) not determinable. ... We use ... flan-t5-xxl ... to match interpretations to human comments.

answer_4.quote: To assess the soundness of interpretations, we randomly sample 100 (Q, I_n) pairs, and ask two external annotators to judge whether or not I_n reasonably follows from question Q.
answer_4.guideline: judge whether the interpretation reasonably follows from the question
